name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest open PR first. It catches routing flaws before they hit users, proving its value without risk. The trade-off is delayed feedback for other PRs, but catching a bad route early saves more time.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode on the newest open PR risks exposing *new* edge cases that could mislead reviewers or break the PR’s core function—validating PR-Agent’s routing flaws while the PR itself may still be unstable. A safer alternative: run PR-Agent in shadow mode on a *stable* PR first, then expand to newer ones once confidence is proven. Settle it by measuring false positives/negatives in shadow mode before risking live PRs.
